cohort: The study included 400 parturient women undergoing cesarean section.
finding: Overall patient satisfaction was high (95.5%), with postoperative complaints (especially pain) being the primary factor associated with dissatisfaction, and joy on hearing newborn cries associated with higher satisfaction.
mod_finding: There was no difference in patient satisfaction in regards to the previous number of LSCS.
cross-section timing: Data was collected on the day of surgery and upon discharge.
